shared_elements: schematic outline figure carved/pecked on rock surface
justification: Both surfaces bear schematic, outline-style figures cut into rock, and both include a profile quadruped with stiff angular legs, which is a broadly comparable but generic convention. A shows a single isolated animal-like creature with zigzag limbs and no companions, while B is dominated by a large frontal human figure with raised arm, phallus and splayed feet surrounded by smaller animals and sign-like marks, so the subject matter, composition and figure repertoire differ substantially.
